heading.text: COPD Patients Are Finally Clearing The Mucus

hero.subheading: No more heavy mornings, endless clearing sessions, or inhalers that only do half the job. This is the first supplement that reaches the COPD buildup from the inside out — with 10 powerful botanicals that work where nothing else can.

benefits.title: Most Treatments Stop at the Surface — This Works From Within
benefits.description: COPD mucus buildup isn't just 'a little cough'. Years of hardened mucus cemented against your airway walls, buried cilia that have stopped sweeping, and a clearing system that can no longer keep up — which means inhalers, Mucinex, and nebulizers barely scratch the surface. SOMARA goes deeper, delivering 10 potent botanicals — Soursop (Graviola), Black Seed Oil, Oregano Oil, Turmeric, and Ginger — that support your body's natural airway detox process from within: loosening stubborn mucus, reducing airway inflammation, and helping your lungs clear from the inside out, not just masking symptoms.

benefits.title: Inhalers Can't Touch Deep Airway Tissue — This Goes Where They Can't
benefits.description: The hallmark of COPD is mucus that hardens against your airway walls over time. When the tiny hairs that are supposed to sweep your lungs clean get buried under years of buildup, that heavy, tight, stuck feeling takes over — especially first thing in the morning. No inhaler can reach that deep hardened layer. SOMARA delivers Soursop, Irish Sea Moss, and Ginger through fast-absorbing sublingual liquid — directly into your system — helping your body naturally clear the mucus layer that survives every morning clearing session, relieve that stuck chest feeling, and reduce the congestion that keeps coming back no matter what you try.

benefits.title: It Clears the Mucus Buildup Causing Your Wheezing, Coughing, and Tightness
benefits.description: Breathing problems are the result of years of mucus hardening against your airway walls and burying the cilia that are supposed to keep your lungs clear. That's why so many COPD patients wheeze when they laugh, spend 20 minutes clearing every morning, or feel winded walking to the next room. SOMARA's Turmeric, Black Seed Oil, and Ginger target airway inflammation — the silent driver of wheezing and tightness. Ashwagandha supports respiratory muscle strength, while Vitamins C and D3 fortify the airway tissues lining your lungs. Shorter clearing sessions, less phlegm, and easier breathing after exertion.

benefits.title: It Supports Airway Clearing — No Matter How Long You've Had COPD
benefits.description: Here's a hard truth: COPD airway buildup doesn't care how many inhalers you've tried or how long you've been managing it. Many patients who've been doing everything right for years still struggle with the same heavy mornings — because the problem isn't the symptoms, it's the hardened buildup nothing swallowed has ever properly reached. SOMARA gives your airways what they need: Chlorella and Chlorophyll to help clear cellular toxin buildup, Moringa's concentrated antioxidants to repair damaged lung tissue, and Oregano Oil's airway-clearing power to reduce the congestion that sets the tone for your whole day. A cleaner foundation — and easier breathing on the outside.

benefits.title: Two Droppers a Day — No Devices, No Guesswork
benefits.description: Steam treatments. Nebulizers. Breathing exercises. Special teas. Expensive air purifiers. You've likely tried some (or all) of them. And while they may help a little, they're exhausting to keep up with — and rarely deliver the deep clearing you need. SOMARA is effortless. In just 2 droppers a day, all 10 botanicals — Soursop, Sea Moss, Moringa, Turmeric, Black Seed Oil, Oregano Oil, Ashwagandha, Chlorella, Chlorophyll, and Ginger — work together to support deep airway clearing, reduce morning congestion and chest heaviness, and rebuild lung tissue over time. No devices. No complicated routines. Just freedom from the wheezing, the embarrassment, and the constant struggle to breathe clearly.
